plan.summary: This 1-4 block is the opening build phase for an off-camp 12-week boxing plan with one weekly S&C session. Week 1 establishes baseline strength with a safe multi-rep squat assessment so later loading can be more accurate. Weeks 2-4 build lower-body force, simple explosive work, upper-body pushing and pulling strength, trunk work, and brief conditioning without creating unnecessary soreness that would interfere with boxing practice. The main program starts in Week 2, and Week 4 slightly trims volume to act as a checkpoint before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength first, keep simple explosive work in, and establish reliable training loads.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier work while keeping the weekly dose recoverable around boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, shift more emphasis toward faster explosive outputs, and stay sharp rather than fatigued.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on each rep. Reset between reps and land softly.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and safely.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy ramping sets, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop if form breaks. This session sets your baseline for future squat loading.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your current baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set and keep the depth and tempo consistent.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet hold limits loading before the legs are challenged.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the rack position tight and torso upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Use a steady lower and press hard from the floor. Leave 2 reps in reserve on each set.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a load or elevation that lets you keep clean reps.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and pause briefly at the top. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if lower-back support is helpful.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back, keep the spine neutral, and stop where hamstring tension is strong. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the load close to the legs and move under control.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down and glutes tight. Only roll as far as you can without losing position.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the ab wheel is too demanding.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall, keep the ribs stacked over the hips, and do not rush the steps.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Switch hands each set and resist side bending.

exercises.name: Bike, brisk incline walk, or jump rope intervals
exercises.notes: Keep the pace crisp but controlled so you finish fresher, not wrecked.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
